title: Tiny Town Merge
shortDescription: Small buildings. Big plans. One very mergeable town.
description: Open crates, merge matching buildings, and turn a tiny patch of land into a thriving town. Earn coins, unlock new plots, and discover buildings across Meadowville and Sunshore.
coverAlt: Tiny Town Merge gameplay with colorful buildings and crates on a green town grid
controls: Tap a crate to open it. Drag matching buildings together, or tap one and then a matching target.
Move buildings onto empty plots or swap them. Keyboard: focus a plot, then press Enter or Space to select and target.
Use the delivery button for crates. The bottom dock opens the shop, upgrades, collection, and settings.
saveNote: Saves locally after gameplay actions. Offline earnings are capped at eight hours. Use one active tab per town; export a backup in Settings.
